content.user_title: Optimize Search Content and Technical SEO
content.value_statement: Search teams need clear guidance for content, metadata, schema, and page performance. This skill provides practical SEO checklists, examples, and optimization patterns for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Guides keyword research and search intent mapping for content plans.
Reviews title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and image alt text.
Provides examples for schema markup, robots.txt, XML sitemaps, and canonical tags.
Lists Core Web Vitals targets and page speed optimization tactics.
Creates SEO publishing checklists for content quality and internal links.
limitations: Does not run live crawls or measure rankings by itself.
Does not replace paid SEO tools or Search Console data.
Requires site goals, audience details, and page context for useful recommendations.
Cannot guarantee ranking gains because search results depend on external factors.

use_cases.title: Plan Search Content
use_cases.description: Build topic clusters, choose target keywords, and map intent before drafting new pages.

use_cases.title: Improve Page Metadata
use_cases.description: Rewrite titles, descriptions, headings, URLs, and image alt text for stronger on-page signals.

use_cases.title: Check Technical SEO
use_cases.description: Review schema, sitemaps, canonical tags, mobile readiness, and Core Web Vitals priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit for a single page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page for SEO. Focus on the title, meta description, H1, URL, and image alt text. Suggest clear improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Build Keyword Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a keyword map for this audience and product. Group terms by intent, page type, priority, and content angle.

prompt_templates.title: Create Publishing Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an SEO publishing checklist for this article. Include content quality, internal links, schema, mobile checks, and page speed tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize Technical Fixes
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these technical SEO findings. Rank fixes by impact, effort, risk, and dependencies. Include Core Web Vitals and indexability concerns.

output_examples.input: Improve a product category page for trail running shoes.
output: Recommended title: Trail Running Shoes for Technical Terrain | Brand
Recommended meta description: Shop stable trail running shoes for rocky routes, mud, and long climbs. Compare grip, cushioning, and fit.
Primary improvements: add comparison copy, strengthen internal links, compress images, and include FAQ content.

output_examples.input: Plan content for a beginner guide about email deliverability.
output: Primary intent: informational research from founders and marketers.
Suggested structure: definition, causes, checklist, tools, common mistakes, and next steps.
Internal link targets: email authentication, sender reputation, newsletter metrics, and spam testing.

output_examples.input: Prioritize SEO fixes after a page speed review.
output: Highest priority: optimize hero images, reduce render-blocking scripts, and reserve space for embeds.
Medium priority: defer noncritical JavaScript and review font loading.
Track impact with Core Web Vitals, organic clicks, and landing page conversion rate.

best_practices: Start with search intent before changing titles, headings, or page structure.
Use specific page data from Search Console, analytics, and crawl tools when available.
Balance keyword usage with clarity, trust, and useful answers for readers.
anti_patterns: Do not stuff keywords into titles, headings, or body copy.
Do not copy competitor pages without adding original value.
Do not treat schema markup as a substitute for helpful content.

faq.question: Can this skill perform live keyword research?
faq.answer: No. It can structure research and analyze supplied keyword data, but it does not access live SEO databases.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Can it generate meta titles and descriptions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft and refine titles, descriptions, headings, and page snippets from your page context.

faq.question: Can it help developers with technical SEO?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers schema, sitemaps, canonical tags, mobile SEO, and Core Web Vitals priorities.

faq.question: Does it guarantee higher rankings?
faq.answer: No. Rankings depend on competition, authority, content quality, and search engine changes.

faq.question: What input improves the results?
faq.answer: Provide the page goal, audience, current copy, target keywords, known issues, and analytics context.
